title: Signal: Unescaped HTML sink $(el).html(payload) (javascript) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the $(el).html(payload) call in javascript code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any $(el).html(payload) call matches, including trusted constant markup. Whether the value is attacker-controlled needs human review.
fpNotes: Rendering trusted constant templates is the common false positive.
